Got any ideas about what'll be covered in the next Steven Bomb? Post them here! Let's go full Ronaldo!

Cry For Help

I'm pretty sure that this episode will be about Rose's tears and the Homeworld's knock-off. Rose's lacrymal essence has been shown to repair both organic and inorganic structures (humans, gems, and presumably unstable geodes). It doesn't seem to be hard light, and it can be safely stored and used long after Rose's passing. What other things could Rose's tears fixed? Warp pads, perhaps?

Peridot's flask robonoids also secrete a liquid capable of repairing inorganic material. Perhaps they can repair the communication hub that Sugilite destroyed. That would explain how this would interrupt Steven's TV-watching.

Keystone Motel

The three most interesting things I think the episode title may refer to are:

The keystone as a central piece at the apex of an arch. The bottom ends of an arch, the springers, experience the most stresses, and the keystone experiences the least amount. But an arch can't be self-supporting without the keystone. I think this episode will cover Steven's changing role in the Crystal Gems. The others have attempted to shield him from as much danger as possible, only very gradually placing more responsibilities on him. Of the Crystal Gems, he has experienced the least amount of stress but he is what holds the group together. Perhaps, after considering the burden being placed on him (losing his healing powers, being abducted for being his own mom, suffering sleep deprivation by trying to keep up with near-immortal aliens) the Crystal Gems order Steven to have a vacation.

This may also refer to the bubbled gems in relation to the Crystal Gems. After being bubbled, the only thing the corrupted gems have to struggle with (aside from their corruption) is a waiting game. The Crystal Gems do all of the heavy lifting, embarking on missions to secure the Earth. "Motel" could refer to their temporary stay in the bowels of the Crystal Temple.

A motor hotel, short-term lodging for passing motorists. Individual Homeworld gems can travel to gem-occupied territories easily with the Galaxy Warp. But I'd imagine that these places would also have ports for Homeworld ships to dock at. And in between territories, depots for gem ships to resupply at and receive maintenance. Maybe this episode is the beginning of the Crystal Gems taking to space.

The keystone effect, the distortion of a projected image caused by the projector being at an angle to the screen. We've seen something similar to this, the display in the Kindergarten that Peridot used. I think this is a stretch though. The image was only distorted because the display was at an angle to the viewer.

Onion Friend

I can understand Steven going to hang out with Onion, but Amethyst? Why would she go? I can only imagine that Onion his hands on another piece of gem tech because of Amethyst, and she doesn't want to deal with another mountain of Dead Guys. That, or there's good food to be had at Onion's house.

Onions are infamous for making people cry, so I wouldn't be surprised if this is a saddening episode in some way. All three characters have suffered the loss or absence of a parental figure in their lives. Steven's technically lost a mother figure twice in his life, with Pearl being poofed by Holo-Pearl. The latter was a temporary loss that Steven reacted to by attempting to fashion a training dummy into Pearl's likeness. Perhaps Onion uses a piece of gem technology to create a substitute father for himself. And/or Amethyst and Onion warm up to each other for their shared tendency toward mischief, causing a lot of trouble.

Historical Friction

Oh my stars please be another backstory episode. Ocean Town, Sapphire and Ruby's relationship, humanity's relationship with gems. Maybe Bismuth?

Friend Ship

The Crystal Gems go to space! Pearl knows how to build spacecraft. After interfacing with the Hand Ship and gathering most of its wreckage, maybe this episode is the beginning of Steven's adventures in space.

Or Connie's parents freak out about her safety and send her away on a ship.
